metadata.modifications: Removed plotting and per-iteration logging, instrumented maximum-iteration exits and recorded 12 significant digits. The original time-loop body executes in consecutive batches in one Octave workspace; equations, source nodal data, parameters, timestep and iteration stopping order unchanged. Case 2 reaction is the original pre-final-update value returned by objfun. This conditional window starts from an external TypeScript-generated state and is not an independent full trajectory.
metadata.sampling: Node 20 r and z every step; all 40 nodes at local step 1, every 1th local step and the final recorded step.

checkpoint.source: TypeScript source-iteration replay; not an independently generated Octave trajectory.
